title: エンディング（ノーマル）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtain has fallen on my first three years with Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the next act is only just getting started. One day, while contemplating where to go from here…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, would you mind helping me again with my next Umastalive?
choice_data_list: Sure, but why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The last time you joined my stream, it made everyone interested in my races!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So many people came to watch me run, and they cheered their hearts out for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now that things have calmed down, I want to give them all a proper thank-you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she asked, I end up joining Hishi Akebono on another live stream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Every day is buono! Big and delicious is the best. ♪ I'm Hishi Akebono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Today, your favorite guest, a.k.a. my trainer, is going to help out again!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Trainer! Great job on your race, Bono! I watched you at the venue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Comments start flying in, and they seem a bit friendlier than the ones we received last time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Let's jump right into today's stream! We're gonna make quick and easy baumkuchen! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll show you how you can make it at home in a frying pan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: First, melt the butter in the microwave. While it's heating up, mix the eggs, sugar, and honey together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Once the wet ingredients are ready, add in the flour. Trainer, could you get the cake flour and baking powder for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's Umastalive moves along swimmingly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Pour the batter into the pan. Now, place the aluminum foil log we made on top of it. Next, wrap the cake sponge round and round the foil!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A pleasantly sweet aroma fills the kitchen as she rolls up the thin sheets of sponge into a cylinder.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And there we go! Our delightfully buono baumkuchen is ready!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now that it's done, let's have some, Trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The piece she gives me is cool enough to eat but still toasty warm.
choice_data_list: Thanks! I can't wait to taste this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A single bite of the cake's fluffy sweetness is enough to make me smile from ear to ear.

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Wow, Trainer sure is enjoying that cake. You have a great trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Yep! I wouldn't want to have anyone else as my trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I asked Trainer to come today because I wanted to thank everybody!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Thank us? What for? I don't remember doing anything…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Do you remember when I introduced Trainer to you all during my Umastalive?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You were all so supportive of me, even though that segment wasn't about cooking!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And so many of you came to watch me race in person! That made me really, really happy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: My race schedule has slowed down now, but I was able to make a lot of great memories during the busy season.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I was only able to do that because all of you kept encouraging me with such happy smiles.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to thank you all. From the bottom of my heart…

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bono! You're a good egg, kiddo. No, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We're gonna keep doing things to the best of our abilities, whether it's cooking or racing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll all continue rooting for Trainer and me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Please keep cheering us on tomorrow, the day after that, and on and on to eternity!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Of course! You've gotta do your best forever and ever too! Ooh! Is that why you made baumkuchen?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oops, I guess my cover's blown.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I decided to make baumkuchen today because it's considered a good luck charm, and there was something I wanted to wish for.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: While making it, I wished that the two of us can continue being happy and growing big together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's kinda embarrassing to have my cover blown, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stream ends with a tsunami of comments and stamps from the viewers.
